profile.headline: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I am a customer-focused software engineer with over 20 years of experience helping organizations build and operate their web applications.  I specialize in backend and infrastructure development primarily for Go and Ruby on Rails applications.  I enjoy designing reliable and maintainable systems with well-written documentation.  I scale my expertise through strong written and verbal communication.

I have a few more details about myself as well as links to my other places on the internet at https://leejones.github.io.

positions.description: Skills: Kubernetes · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Thanos · Prometheus.io · Vitess · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Elasticsearch · Go (Programming Language) · Docker Products

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: At Digital Scientists, I worked in front-end development, back-end development, and server setup.  My experience there ranged from Ruby on Rails to jQuery to Google Analyitcs.  It was a healthy mix of just about everything to help clients get marketing down to a science.

positions.title: Student Ministries Media Associate
positions.description: At Northside, I worked mainly with the Student Ministry to provide web and video multimedia for communication and teaching.  I developed and maintained several websites ranging from informational sites to complex event registration sites.  My video work included editing event promotions and highlights, and shooting video.  A highlight of the experience at Northside was helping install and create content for a in-house video communication system.
